P0_SCOPE: Single-seat independently managed rear-seat module preserving the claim-critical architecture: bilateral longitudinal paths, controlled ride-down, separate seatback-rotation control, multi-state lock/trigger, rebound control, and restraint-path interface.
P0_IS_NOT: R4.2; production seat; validated crash-safety system; measured-performance claim; R4.1 mutation.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Inline or load-washer interface in 110L load path
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Full-scale shall exceed the verified proof-load envelope and maintain operating region within calibrated sensor linear range. Preliminary procurement: 50 kN class if the source absorber envelope is used as the design case; NOT TEST DATA.
INSTRUMENTATION.CALIBRATION: Traceable force calibration before campaign; zero/tare at installed temperature
INSTRUMENTATION.SYNC: Common hardware timebase with all dynamic channels
INSTRUMENTATION.UNCERTAINTY: Use calibrated system uncertainty; record sensor certificate and channel uncertainty budget
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: 50 kN is a design selection based on source concept peak force envelope, not a measured P0 result.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Inline or load-washer interface in 110R load path
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Same rule as F01; symmetric channel class preferred.
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Independent left/right channels are required for load sharing and asymmetry.

INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Verified proof load governs; preliminary 50 kN class when source 18-22 kN/side and 25-35 kN damping envelope is used for procurement sizing; NOT TEST DATA.
INSTRUMENTATION.UNCERTAINTY: Calibrated system uncertainty + fixture alignment error
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Prefer inline transducer over indirect rail force for absorber law.

INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Full scale shall exceed source 180 mm ride-down and 210 mm total-travel concept envelope. Preliminary: >=250 mm travel class; NOT TEST DATA.
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Also use redundant visual/encoder verification in dynamic tests.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Rigidly attached to 120 near center of mass datum
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Full scale shall exceed verified event envelope. For a screening case based on the source example 25.6 g peak, FS must be >25.6 g with engineering margin; a 50 g class is the minimum procurement tier. NOT TEST DATA.
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Source 25.6 g is explicitly a design-study input, not T-OCS evidence.

INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Same selection rule as A01, scaled to the actual test-rig measured regime
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Required for relative acceleration and event synchronization.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Absolute/inertial angular sensor on 160 frame referenced to base datum
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Full scale shall exceed source conceptual envelope (-10 to +25 deg) and any verified overshoot; select at least 2x the pretest envelope after shakedown. NOT TEST DATA.
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: A redundant high-speed video measurement is recommended.

INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Proof-load-based; preliminary class set after static shakedown load acquisition
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: If direct load cell integration threatens kinematics, use instrumented pin/strain-gauged link.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: 170 module state indicator/encoder or discrete sensor
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: State sensor shall be non-saturating over all mechanical states; discrete or absolute position sensing acceptable
INSTRUMENTATION.CALIBRATION: State-position correlation check against physical gauge
INSTRUMENTATION.UNCERTAINTY: Timing uncertainty dominated by sensor/DAQ latency
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Measure transitions S0-S5 as realized; do not assume times from concept board.

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Absorber body and, where relevant, fluid/reservoir surface
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Must cover source operating concept -40 to +80 C plus calibration margin
INSTRUMENTATION.SAMPLING: >=100 S/s dynamic; slower acceptable for soak

INSTRUMENTATION.LOCATION: Camera side view and/or orthogonal views covering rails, seatback, lock and absorber travel
INSTRUMENTATION.RANGE_BASIS: Frame rate selected so the shortest event of interest has multiple frames; start at >=1000 fps for screening and increase when event-feature resolution requires
INSTRUMENTATION.SAMPLING: Video frame rate governed by test
INSTRUMENTATION.CALIBRATION: Lens calibration, geometric target calibration, trigger timing check
INSTRUMENTATION.NOTES: Video is corroborating evidence, not sole force/stiffness evidence.

TEST_MATRIX.INTERFACE_PART: Complete P0 excluding removable sensor cables if separately weighed
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Fully supported at defined fixture datum; no external preload
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Condition; tare; weigh; repeat; document configuration and balance state
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Repeatability must be within calibrated measurement uncertainty; otherwise investigate setup/configuration

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Determine CG in defined P0 coordinate system
TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Static reaction balance / multi-point weighing fixture
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Known datum support points; no free translation
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Acquire support reactions at defined orientations; solve CG from measured reactions and surveyed geometry
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Residual/reconciliation must fall within the fixture measurement uncertainty budget
TEST_MATRIX.OUTPUT: CG vector in P0 frame + uncertainty

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Controlled pendulum/rotation test fixture or certified inertia measurement system
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Rigidly mounted to fixture; axis survey traceable to P0 frame
TEST_MATRIX.INSTRUMENTATION: Angular displacement/velocity sensors + fixture reaction measurements
TEST_MATRIX.SAMPLING: >=1 kS/s for dynamic rotation fixture; higher if system requires
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Measure known rotational response about principal or orthogonal axes; solve tensor; document fixture contribution subtraction
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Repeatability within instrument uncertainty; cross-check tensor symmetry/positive-definiteness

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Determine density/material mass model inputs where CAD mass cannot be trusted from material definition
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Specified material lot and heat treatment
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Identify material lot; measure density; retain MTR/CoA
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Lot result traceable to certificate and measurement uncertainty
TEST_MATRIX.TRACE: R4.1 -> material regions used in CAD mass model

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Measure friction at each structurally relevant sliding interface
TEST_MATRIX.INTERFACE_PART: S1/S2 guide/runner and any friction-controlled lock/contact interfaces
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Surface finish, lubrication, temperature and velocity recorded
TEST_MATRIX.INSTRUMENTATION: Normal and tangential force transducers + displacement/velocity
TEST_MATRIX.SAMPLING: >=2 kS/s static/quasi-static; >=20 kS/s dynamic if rate effects investigated
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Condition surfaces; apply defined normal load; run multiple velocity directions/cycles; identify static and kinetic coefficients
TEST_MATRIX.REPEAT_COUNT: >=5 cycles per configuration unless fixture repeatability dictates more
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Stable repeatable identification with documented uncertainty; configuration-specific results retained
TEST_MATRIX.OUTPUT: mu_s/mu_k vs normal load/velocity/temp where applicable

TEST_MATRIX.INTERFACE_PART: Rail/stop/guide contacts and mechanical stops used in P0
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Actual surface materials and contact geometry
TEST_MATRIX.SAMPLING: >=20 kS/s for dynamic contact; slower for quasi-static characterization
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Acquire loading/unloading curves; fit local tangent/contact law in the operating displacement region
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Model fit residuals and repeatability reported; no generic stiffness substitution

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Controlled repeated impacts at known approach velocity
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Measure loading/unloading energy and velocity dependence; identify damping law
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Unique fit without unstable extrapolation; report range of validity

TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Known impact velocity, normal load and surface state
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Compute rebound/approach velocity ratio; repeat over defined velocity range
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Repeatable coefficient/relationship; reject runs with fixture motion or secondary contacts

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Quasi-static and controlled dynamic extension/compression over available stroke
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Correct mounting clevises and loading axis
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Cycle through full allowable travel; identify regions, hysteresis and end effects
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Curve must be traceable to exact cartridge serial and configuration; no curve averaging across different cartridges without provenance

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Multiple commanded stroke rates spanning the intended operating regime
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Same temperature/configuration recorded for each run
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Run rate sweep; derive velocity from calibrated displacement channel; fit only within tested domain
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Rate dependency identified without extrapolation outside measured domain

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Same mechanical profile at multiple controlled temperatures covering validated lab range; source concept notes -40 to +80 C operating range
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Thermal soak verified; cartridge serial tracked
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Thermally condition; verify soak; run identical profile; compare force/work/hysteresis
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Temperature effect quantified; no substitution of untested temperature behavior

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Repeated controlled cycles within validated stroke/rate envelope
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Cycle; inspect; re-characterize after defined blocks; retain all serials
TEST_MATRIX.REPEAT_COUNT: Per supplier/test-lab capability; sufficient to expose drift, with count defined before test execution
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Drift quantified; any structural/leakage degradation recorded

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Identify bolt/joint stiffness and preload sensitivity
TEST_MATRIX.INTERFACE_PART: Hinges, rail mounts, absorber clevis and lock mounts
TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Controlled axial/shear preload and joint excitation
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Exact fastener class, grip length, washers, nut and torque/preload method recorded
TEST_MATRIX.SAMPLING: >=1 kS/s quasi-static; higher for dynamic compliance
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Measure load-displacement at multiple preload states; isolate joint compliance from fixture compliance
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Configuration-specific stiffness law with preload state retained

TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Sweep both directions through operating range; separate friction, clearance and elastic compliance
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Compliance law resolved sufficiently to reproduce measured hysteresis/clearance

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Measure lock/trigger state transition and unintended-release behavior
TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Controlled acceleration/force event plus manual fault cases
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Restraint path mechanically independent and secured
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Exercise S0->S1->S2->S4/S5 as applicable; test no-trigger, trigger and disturbance cases; record release latency
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: No unintended release in defined non-trigger cases; intended transition reproducible; source timing targets treated as design requirements to be verified, not assumed results
TEST_MATRIX.OUTPUT: State transition truth table and measured latency

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Prove basic guided translation and stop behavior without occupant
TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: External controlled actuator/fixture or equivalent bench load
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Hard travel limits installed; absorber/lock configuration documented
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Dry-run; low-load; incremental load to verified safe envelope; record travel and rail load sharing
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Smooth travel, no binding, both rails engaged, stop/rebound functions remain available

TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Ride-down path independently restrained in fixture when isolating rotation path
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Apply controlled rotation while preventing longitudinal carriage translation, then repeat with carriage free
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Rotation-control path produces distinct measurable reaction independent of absorber force-stroke law

TEST_MATRIX.LOAD: Controlled reverse carriage motion after primary stroke
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: Primary stroke completed within test fixture; stop conditions enforced
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Drive carriage through primary stroke; release/reverse under controlled conditions; measure reverse velocity and secondary excursion
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Reverse motion is measurably controlled and state transition is recorded; no uncontrolled return or interference

TEST_MATRIX.OBJECTIVE: Integrated controlled dynamic screening for coupled translation + rotation + rebound
TEST_MATRIX.INPUT: Vehicle pulse / initial velocity only when externally sourced and approved; otherwise use laboratory-shaped input documented as a test command, not a vehicle pulse
TEST_MATRIX.BOUNDARY: No human occupants; ATD only after subsystem gates
TEST_MATRIX.SAMPLING: >=20 kS/s dynamic channels; video >=1000 fps starting point
TEST_MATRIX.PROCEDURE: Execute only after component characterization and proof load checks; synchronize input and response; post-test inspection
TEST_MATRIX.REPEAT_COUNT: >=3 screening events or until evidence sufficiency is demonstrated
TEST_MATRIX.CRITERION: Evidence of state sequence, load paths, translation, rotation control and rebound without uncontrolled failure
TEST_MATRIX.RAW_DATA: Full synchronized DAQ package + video + configuration manifest
TEST_MATRIX.OUTPUT: Integrated physical evidence set for Manus
TEST_MATRIX.TRACE: R4.1 -> prototype architecture -> future MBD/FE correlation

MANUS_HANDOFF_CONTRACT.rule: Each P0 result becomes an evidence artifact. The prototype definition does not close any physical input. Manus validation remains required.
MANUS_HANDOFF_CONTRACT.configuration_identity: P0 assembly revision + component serials + test fixture revision + sensor calibration revisions + raw-data hash must be captured in every dataset.

principles: No uncontrolled occupant/crash test at P0 stage.
Start component -> joint -> subsystem -> integrated bench dynamic -> ATD/sled only after prior evidence gates.
Mechanical hard stops at both ends of travel and anti-jam provisions on both rail paths.
Fixture retention must be independently secured against the maximum verified pre-test load envelope.

Abort on structural crack/buckle, guide disengagement, unintended lock release, loss of sensor integrity, fixture movement, unexpected free motion, or any load/temperature beyond verified safe envelope.
Dynamic tests require remote operation, physical guarding/containment as appropriate, emergency stop, and post-test inspection/requalification.
SAFETY.stop_rule: No numerical stop load is invented. The test supervisor shall derive the machine stop threshold from the verified fixture/component proof-load certificate and sensor range before each test campaign; operate below that verified threshold.

BUILD_RELEASE.ready_now: Architecture, component list, deviation control, instrumentation concept, test fixtures and data/evidence structure are defined.
BUILD_RELEASE.not_ready_for_true_manufacturing_release: Exact CAD-driven hole/edge coordinates, hardpoints, tolerance stack, material certificates and selected absorber serial/configuration are not present in the V7 PDF alone.
BUILD_RELEASE.critical_action: Use authoritative R4.1 STEP/native drawings to populate fabrication-critical geometry. Do not measure raster pixels from concept boards and call them released dimensions.
